description: This file contains the implementation of the ProductReviewDao interface, providing database access methods for handling ProductReview entities, including retrievals by customer, product, and combinations thereof, utilizing QueryDSL with JPA for query construction.

classes.name: ProductReviewDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ProductReviewDao interface, providing specific database access logic for product reviews, extending the generic DAO implementation and annotated as a Spring repository.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews submitted by a specific customer, joining related entities for comprehensive fetch.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews for a specific product, including related customer and merchant data.

methods.name: getByProductAndCustomer
methods.description: Fetches a single review by product ID and customer ID, including associated descriptions and related entities.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves product reviews for a specific product and language, used for localized review display.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a specific product review by its unique identifier.
